audience: Dutch freelancers and small businesses that keep their books and VAT in Taxmo

useCases.title: Check the VAT position for a quarter
useCases.text: Get the VAT filing for one quarter, with the amounts per VAT grid row and the total to pay or to receive. Read the business profile too.

useCases.title: Review the annual summary
useCases.text: Get revenue, expenses and VAT per quarter for one year. List the bookkeeping entries for the same period.

useCases.title: Find overdue invoices
useCases.text: List the invoices, then open one to see its lines and payment status, such as overdue. List the customer and supplier contacts too.

useCases.title: Look up invoices and contacts by your own id
useCases.text: Get one invoice or one contact by the externalId you set in your own system.

useCases.title: Log time or hours
useCases.text: Add a time entry to a project, or add hours to the urencriterium log in the Netherlands. Each call adds a new record, so call once per entry.
